name: Murase Tatsumi
source:
A man who was a former direct subordinate of [url=https://vndb.org/c88474]Kyouka[/url]. After accidentally dropping some documents, he saw Kyouka's panties from under his desk and was caught staring by her. Because of this, he often found himself at the receiving end of Kyouka's abuse until she resigned due to marriage, much to his delight.

His joy was short-lived as a few years later, Kyouka returns to his company. Even though he no longer works under Kyouka, she still pushes tasks off on him and constantly abuses him about the quality of his work.

[spoiler]Overworked and stressed because of Kyouka, he starts using hookup sites for stress relief. There, he finds the diary of a woman named Usagi-san, who frequently uploads lewd pictures of herself. By chance, he discovers that the true identity of Usagi-san is none other than Kyouka.

One day, tired of Kyouka's constant abuse, he uses this knowledge to blackmail Kyouka into becoming his sex friend for two months.[/spoiler]
